# Start Rule

Source: [4455](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4455); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Start Rule](../../api/actions/start-rule.md).

<a id="wiki-4455-n1"></a>

- Start Rule runs a subroutine simultaneously without pausing the caller and inherits the caller's event context.

<a id="wiki-4455-n2"></a>

- If no corresponding subroutine exists it is ignored; Already Executing policy is scoped to the same player/global entity and defaults to Restart Rule.
